neighbours.label: population prevalence, familial heritability, or household-wide impact of chronic medical, psychiatric, neurodevelopmental, or addiction disorders
fire: National surveillance reports estimate that roughly 1 in 44 children in the country has autism spectrum disorder.
Federal health surveys show that nearly 1 in 4 adults experiences a diagnosable mental health disorder during their lifetime.
Twin and pedigree studies confirm that schizophrenia often runs in families due to shared genetic risk.
Pediatricians note that asthma and severe food allergies frequently run in families across consecutive generations.
In the general population, prevalence rates of inflammatory bowel disease have increased steadily since 1990.
When alcohol dependence takes hold in a home, every member of the family has to adapt to the ongoing strain.
Public health bulletins report that roughly 1 in 100 people worldwide is affected by epilepsy or recurrent seizures.
Many people struggling with obsessive-compulsive disorder delay seeking treatment for years because of persistent stigma.
quiet: National transportation reports estimate that roughly 1 in 44 commuters in the country travels by ferry.
Federal housing surveys show that nearly 1 in 4 households renovates its kitchen during a ten-year period.
Economic history studies confirm that artisanal bakery shops often remain in families across several generations.
Sociologists note that musical hobbies and choir participation frequently run in families within rural towns.
In the general electorate, participation rates in municipal school-board elections have declined steadily since 1990.
When a sudden winter storm shuts down the highway, every resident of the valley has to rearrange travel plans.
Aviation bulletins report that roughly 1 in 100 regional flights is delayed each winter by coastal fog.
Many homeowners considering rooftop solar panels delay filing applications for years because of permit fees.

notes: Clean +g -u pole (max 18.88). Probing showed prevalence figures (1 in N children/adults), familial heritability (runs in families), general-population disease rates, and household-wide addiction impact fire 0.23-0.75 while non-medical population/family statistics stay 0.01-0.14.
